facts.fact: Beau 在八点刚过把车停在 Jax 的卡车旁，发现 Jax 已经先到，站在南边围栏举着水平仪，Dad 正就某事跟他争执。
facts.anchor: I parked beside Jax’s truck shortly after eight.

facts.fact: Rosie 站在货车旁，髋部夹着写字板、头发束起，从二十英尺外跟 Jax 争执，而 Jax 明显装作她不存在。
facts.anchor: She stood beside the wagon with a clipboard tucked against one hip, hair tied back, arguing with Jax from twenty feet away

facts.fact: Beau 两周前还对这些一无所感，如今却会注意到 Carson 偏离她日程的时刻。
facts.anchor: Two weeks ago, none of that meant anything to me.

facts.fact: Carson 十点前检查牛犊，随后复核瓶装牛奶的数量。
facts.anchor: She checked the calves before ten. Reviewed bottled milk quantities after.

facts.fact: 接近中午时 Carson 拿着两瓶水朝 Beau 他们走来，递给 Beau 一瓶并叮嘱他补水。
facts.anchor: Around noon, she crossed toward us carrying two water bottles.

facts.fact: Beau 答应在午饭后更换那段三根、也许四根需要替换的围栏，估计只需一两个小时。
facts.anchor: Three posts, maybe four needed to be replaced, it wouldn’t take longer than an hour or two.

facts.fact: 那次差点接吻里，Carson 的嘴唇离 Beau 只有不到一英寸，她的香草味始终萦绕着他。
facts.anchor: Her lips that had been just short of an inch away from mine

facts.fact: 一周前 Beau 与 Carson 之间的沉默还会让人想填补，但今天不会了。
facts.anchor: A week ago, silence between us would’ve felt like something to fill.
